# Redirect

Redirect every matched request to a fixed URL.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | `redirect` |
| **Category** | Transform |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | text | **yes** | — | Full target URL including scheme, e.g. https://example.com. |
| `permanent` | true/false | no | — | Use 301 instead of 302. |
